node.label: Balasubramanian-Koblitz: E[r] lies in E(F_{q^k}) iff r | q^k - 1
node.statement: Let r be a prime dividing #E(F_q) with r not dividing q - 1 and gcd(r,q) = 1. Then E[r] is contained in E(F_{q^k}) if and only if r divides q^k - 1.
node.scope: So for r not dividing q-1 the Weil-pairing MOV attack can work in E(F_{q^k}) with k the embedding degree; the case r | q-1 is excluded.
